'''Shiying''' is an NPC in [[Huanglong]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Shiying:''' Man, this place is really big...
:'''Shiying:''' Back in [[Tiger's Maw Mine]], a few rounds were all it took to explore the whole place.
:{{DIcon}} Have you been to Tiger's Maw Mine?
:'''Shiying:''' Yeah... I grew up in the mine. I almost succeeded our family business as a miner.
:'''Shiying:''' But I wanted to see the world myself, so I joined Lollo Logistics and became a courier.
:'''Shiying:''' Turns out I got assigned to a place of vast expansion. And I'm able to witness those novel sights by myself!
:'''Shiying:''' The peach trees of [[Taoyuan Vale]], the fireflies of [[Lake Deerslumber]], the lighthouse of the [[Tiderise Cliff]]... I never get tired of seeing these places!
:'''Shiying:''' If you get the chance, you really should go see it.
{{Dialogue End}}
